I am an old woman here in Zomba, and this small plot of 0.25 hectares I keep for beans mixed with my maize and pumpkins. Beans do not need much chemical fertilizer because they pull goodness from the air themselves, so I save my little fertilizer money for the maize plots. I will put some manure from my goats and chickens on this plot before planting, and I keep seeds from last year's harvest like my mother taught me. I cannot afford pesticides or irrigation, so I depend on the rains and my own two hands, with help from my daughter-in-law when the weeding is heavy.
